name: freqtrade-strategies Strategy002
translation_notes: Entry: RSI(14) below 30 and close below the lower Bollinger(20, 2) band (bands on close here; the original uses typical price). Dropped from the entry: slow stochastic %K < 20 (no stochastic in the registry) and a TA-Lib hammer candle (no candle patterns). Exit: the original exits when Parabolic SAR is above close and Fisher-RSI > 0.3. Fisher-RSI is tanh(0.1 x (RSI - 50)), a monotone transform of RSI, so Fisher-RSI > 0.3 is exactly RSI > 53.1 (50 + 10 x atanh(0.3)). SAR is not in the registry; 'SAR above close' (price has turned down) is approximated by close below the previous close. The ROI table (0 min: 5%, 20: 4%, 30: 3%, 60: 1%) becomes a single 5% take-profit. Stop-loss 10% kept. Timeframe changed 5m -> 1h.
